items.titleZh: 这一“修复”方案本无法拯救F1西班牙大奖赛
items.summaryZh: 针对西班牙大奖赛观感平淡的问题，外界多归咎于马德里赛道缺乏超车机会，但乔恩·诺布尔指出战术变化不足也是被忽视的因素，而所谓的“修复”方案本无法拯救这场比赛。

items.originalTitle: 这一'修复'方案本无法拯救F1西班牙大奖赛
items.summaryEn: The lack of overtaking at the Madring circuit has been blamed for the Spanish Grand Prix's poor spectacle, but another overlooked factor was the lack of strategic variation, meaning track changes alone would not have saved the race.
detailZh: 西班牙大奖赛未能呈现出今年其他一级方程式比赛所提供的那种精彩场面，这不可避免地让人们把焦点放在了马德里赛道缺乏超车机会这一点上。
组合式弯道、护栏收窄点以及缺乏宽阔的重刹车区域——尤其是在5号弯——都使得超越对手变得极其困难。
正如The 比赛（比赛媒体）在周日透露的那样，马德里赛道的主管方已经在计划对三个关键弯角进行改造，以迎接2027年，并期待明年的比赛能呈现出更多看点，这也就不足为奇了。
但导致比赛缺乏精彩对抗的不仅仅是赛道布局，另一个影响比赛走向的因素是战略上的变化也不多。
再无聊的赛道布局，只要轮胎策略被彻底打乱，也能奉献精彩的对决。
如果通往方格旗的最快路线变得不明确，各车队就会采取不同的策略，同时由此产生的速度差也会制造出并轮缠斗的机会。
马德里赛道就出现了那种摩纳哥或索契式的现象：硬胎（在西班牙站是C2配方）足够支撑整场比赛——加斯利就证明了这一点，他一直坚持到倒数第二圈才进行强制配方更换，换掉他起步时使用的轮胎。
周五首次练习后，鉴于观察到的高磨损程度，曾有人半开玩笑地称可能出现六停策略；但随后情况戏剧性地转变为轻松的一停，令人惊讶。
哈斯车手奥康表示，轮胎的表现是导致比赛中没有太多精彩对抗的限制因素之一，因为只要车手不在前车尾流中待太久，就可以毫无顾虑地持续推进。
他说：“问题在于第二节 阶段（节段）轮胎表现得太稳定了，一旦你跟上前车，你就会损失大量抓地力。”
“当我给其他车让蓝旗的时候，我轻松就损失了半秒，甚至十分之七秒。之后抓地力又会恢复，因为这完全和过热有关。”
“一旦过热降下来，你的速度就回来了。所以这就是为什么没有超车。基本上来说，节奏太快了。”
“从你进站的那一刻到最后，简直就是120%的状态。而且因为没出现颗粒化，我们才取得了这样的结果。如果我们周五就有一场比赛，情况会好得多！”
这样的结果不可避免地引发了质疑：如果轮胎配方更偏激进一些，马德里赛道这场大戏会不会更精彩？
一个美好的设想是：如果去掉C2硬胎在耐热性和机械耐磨性上带来的那份从容，西班牙大奖赛本来会更好看。
这意味着，如果被迫使用更软的配方，车手们在轮胎撑不完全程的情况下会面临更大挑战，从而带来更多刺激。
这个想法不错，但遗憾的是，现实很残酷，因为要理解决定一场比赛能否成为策略杰作的种种复杂因素并不容易。
首先，C2 和 C3 在表现和特性上有明显差异，这意味着虽然硬胎适合跑完整场比赛，中性胎的表现却明显差得多，而且更容易出现轮胎起粒的风险。
正如迈凯伦的皮亚斯特里所说：“中性胎简直糟透了。它实际上只在一圈内表现不错，之后就非常糟糕。”
不过，轮胎衰退加剧并不自动意味着进站次数更多。它可能导致（尤其是在超车困难时）更多的轮胎管理和赛车远远偏离节奏，最终呈现的场面就和周日的比赛一样。
此外，马德里赛道有一个重要因素将永远不利于多次进站的比赛，那就是维修区通道的长度。
在那里更换轮胎大约需要25秒——这是本赛季损失时间最大的赛道之一——所以车队总是想尽量减少换胎的必要性。
根据马德里赛道的实际情况，倍耐力认为把配方调软一档——使用C3/C4/C5而不是C2/C3/C4——并不能提升比赛的观赏性。
这是因为，正如倍耐力赛车运动负责人达里奥·马拉富斯基所指出的，从车手们在比赛中短暂使用C3和C4轮胎时苦苦支撑的表现来看，那样做只会把比赛变成一场艰难的轮胎管理大戏。
再加上马德里赛道凭借倾斜的La Monumental弯道以及大量的弯角，成为赛历中对轮胎要求最具挑战性的赛道之一，这也会因高磨损程度而增加安全风险的可能性。
“这将是一场因高磨损而需要两次进站的比赛，”马拉法斯基对The 比赛表示，“从纸面上看，你可以说‘好吧，这必须是一次两次进站的比赛’。”
“但由于交通状况的影响，车手们最终只会像加斯利那样做。”
“把C2作为比赛用胎是个好选择，这让车队在早期安全车出现的情况下仍有可能一次进站完成比赛。如果用C3/C4/C5就太过分了。”
如果再选择更软的轮胎，排位赛也会出现麻烦。实际上，使用C4轮胎的车队在争夺发车位时，仅仅跑一个单圈冲刺，轮胎就因过热而发出尖啸。
C5轮胎很可能会性能断崖式下滑，基本没什么用处。
马拉富斯基补充道："即使用软胎只跑一圈，经过纪念性弯道（La Monumental）之后，后轮过热的问题就已经出现了。如果软胎是C5，也许在排位赛中也会有热衰退的风险。那就得不偿失了。"
现实情况是，一场比赛能呈现多种策略并行的完美组合、还是变成毫无悬念的轻松一停，抑或陷入彻底混乱，三者之间的差距有时并不大。
由于马德里赛道非常平整、抓地力很高，各车队在赛前就清楚，只要能避免轮胎起粒的风险，一停策略就是可行的。
如果不能避免，正如一位工程师所说，比赛就会变成一场混乱、轮胎严重衰退、两停甚至更多次进站的起粒大混战。
虽然后者听起来很刺激，但实际上它同样有风险，会带来一样糟糕的结果：那就是那种进站循环没完没了、整场比赛毫无叙事线索的大奖赛。
马德里赛道一些注定的特点——平整且高抓地力的表面、La Monumental弯角所承受的巨大作用力、以及很长的维修区通道——意味着除非超车机会得到改善，否则很难通过其他手段鼓励更多的进站。
所有人的目光都集中在明年赛道会做出哪些改动上，因为为超车打开大门，也将是提升比赛策略性元素的最佳方式。
detailEn: The failure of the Spanish Grand Prix to produce the kind of spectacle offered by other Formula 1 races this year has inevitably focused on the lack of overtaking opportunities around the Madring circuit.
Combined entries, barrier pinch points and a lack of wide, heavy braking zones - especially at Turn 5 - all contributed to making it extremely difficult to pass a rival.

It is little wonder, as The Race revealed on Sunday, that Madring chiefs are already planning changes to three key corners for 2027 with the expectation that next year's race produces a bit more of a show.
But it was not just the track layout that contributed to a lack of action, as another factor in how things played out was that there was not much strategic variation either.
Even the most boring of track layouts can deliver thrillers if tyre strategy gets blown open.
Make the fastest route to the chequered flag unclear and you get teams taking different approaches, plus the kinds of pace offset that create the circumstances for wheel-to-wheel action.

The Madring delivered one of those Monaco/Sochi-style phenomena where the hard tyre (the C2 compound in Spain) was good enough to last the whole race - as Pierre Gasly proved by waiting until the penultimate lap for his mandatory compound switch to get off what he had started the race with.

After tongue-in-cheek claims after first running on Friday of a potential six-stopper being on the cards, based on the high levels of degradation seen, the transformation into an easy one-stopper was remarkable.

Haas driver Esteban Ocon said the behaviour of the tyres was one of the limiting factors in why there was not much action in the race, because drivers could push on without fear of excessive degradation as long as they did not spend too much time in the dirty air of the car ahead.
"The thing is that it was so consistent, the tyres on the second stint, that as soon as you were following another car, you were losing so much grip," he said.
"When I was doing blue flags to other cars, I was losing half a second, seven tenths easily. And then after it was coming back because it was all about overheating.
"As soon as the overheating was coming down, you had pace again. So that's why there was no overtaking. It was too fast, the pace, basically.
"It was like 120% from as soon as you pitted to the end. And because the graining didn't happen, that's where we ended up. If we had a race on Friday, it would have been much better!"
This outcome has inevitably prompted questions about whether the Madring spectacle would have been more entertaining had the tyre compounds been a bit more on the aggressive side.
It is a nice theory that if you took away the comfort of the thermal and mechanical robustness of the C2 hard tyre the Spanish GP would have been better.
That suggests that, forced onto softer compounds, drivers would have had a more challenging time in having rubber that did not last the whole distance, thereby producing more excitement.
The idea is good, but sadly reality bites when it comes to understanding the complex factors that dictate whether races become strategic masterclasses.

First, there is a notable difference in behaviour and characteristics between the C2 and the C3, which means that, while the hard was good for the whole race, the medium was significantly not as good and much more prone to the risk of graining.
As McLaren's Oscar Piastri said: "The medium tyre was just awful. It was good for literally one lap, but then it was terrible."

Increased degradation does not automatically mean more stops though. It can (especially when overtaking is difficult) lead to more tyre management and cars running well off the pace, and you end up with the same spectacle as we got on Sunday.
Plus, one important element at Madring that will forever speak against multi-stop races is the length of the pitlane.
Swapping tyres there costs around 25 seconds - one of the biggest losses of the season - so teams are always going to try to minimise the need to change tyres.
Based on the evidence from the Madring, Pirelli felt that going a step softer with the compounds - bringing the C3/C4/C5 rather than the C2/C3/C4 - was not a way to improve the spectacle.

That is because, as Pirelli's head of motorsport, Dario Marrafuschi, pointed out, based on the struggles that drivers had with the C3 and C4 in the short stints in which they managed to keep them alive in the race, it would have simply turned the race into a major management drama.

Throw into the mix too that the Madring, thanks to the banked La Monumental and high numbers of corners, is one of the most challenging tracks on the calendar for tyres, then it would also increase the possibility of safety dangers thanks to the high levels of wear.
"It would have been a two-stop race with a high wear," Marrafuschi told The Race. "On paper you can say, 'OK, it must be a two-stopper'.
"But, because of traffic, drivers would just end up doing what Gasly did.
"It was a good choice to have the C2 as a race compound and give teams the possibility to have one-stop in case of an early safety car. The C3/C4/C5 would have been too much."
Going softer would also have caused trouble in qualifying. As it was, the C4 teams took into the fight for grid positions was screaming from overheating doing a single push lap.
The C5 would probably have fallen off a cliff and been pretty useless.

Marrafuschi added: "Even during one lap with the soft, after La Monumental, the overheating of the rear was there. If the soft was a C5, maybe you would run the risk of thermal degradation during qualifying as well. It wouldn't pay the bill."
The reality is that the margins between a race delivering a perfect strategy mix of different approaches, a nailed on easy one-stopper, and complete chaos are sometimes not very much.
With Madrid's track being super-smooth, and offering high grip, teams knew going into the race that if they could avoid the risk of graining, then the one-stop strategy was on.
If not, as one engineer said, then it would instead have turned into a chaotic, heavy-degradation, two-stop-plus graining fest.
While the latter may sound exciting, it actually risks producing something that is equally as bad: one of those grands prix where there is just an endless cycle of stops so the race has no narrative.

Some of the nailed-on elements of Madring - the smooth, high-grip surface, the forces through La Monumental, and the long pitlane - mean that unless overtaking opportunities are improved there is little that can be done to encourage more stops.
All eyes are on what track changes are done next year because opening the door for passes will be the best way to improve the strategy element too.

items.summaryZh: 尼科·罗斯伯格认为，乔治·拉塞尔目前可能正被一种类似当年他试图扭转对刘易斯·汉密尔顿连败局面时的“疯狂动力”所驱动，以在与基米·安东内利的竞争中扭转局势。
items.originalTitle: 罗斯伯格：拉塞尔或正以“疯狂动力”应对安东内利的挑战
items.summaryEn: Nico Rosberg believes George Russell is likely being driven by a similar "insane motivation" to turn the tables on Kimi Antonelli as he once was to get the better of Lewis Hamilton after recurring defeats.
detailZh: 乔治·拉塞尔：梅赛德斯车手输给基米·安东内利将感到“痛苦”，尼科·罗斯伯格如是说，同时这位车手被看好将迎来突破

乔治·拉塞尔谈虚拟安全车如何影响了他在西班牙大奖赛中的比赛
尼科·罗斯伯格认为，乔治·拉塞尔目前将受到类似程度的“疯狂动力”驱动，以扭转对基米·安东内利的局面，就像他当年在反复失利后要战胜刘易斯·汉密尔顿一样。
拉塞尔今年首次成为世界冠军的希望日益渺茫，状态正佳的梅赛德斯队友安东内利在积分榜榜首将领先优势扩大到81分。
自从赢得3月的赛季揭幕战澳大利亚大奖赛后，季前夺冠热门拉塞尔在两人均完赛的最近10场比赛中仅两次领先安东内利，这位英国人目睹这位年轻的意大利人在蒙扎-马德里背靠背比赛中拿下本赛季第七和第八场胜利。

周日的比赛后，拉塞尔获得第五名，罗斯伯格在天空体育 F1上被问及他当年在2016年从被梅赛德斯队友汉密尔顿彻底击败后反弹赢得世界冠军的经历。
“我很大程度上是被痛苦所驱动，”罗斯伯格回忆道。
“主观上，不断输给刘易斯是痛苦的，而这恰恰驱动了一种疯狂的动力。
“乔治将处于类似的情况。他现在会如此拼命地想要找到提升。
“他会非常努力，因为我知道乔治不会放弃，他讨厌被基米一次又一次击败的局面。
“他会超级努力，但这有点困难，因为很难理解他的速度去哪了。”
2026年西班牙大奖赛集锦
拉塞尔在梅赛德斯的前四个赛季中有三个赛季是车队得分最高的车手，其中三年里两次胜过汉密尔顿（2022年和2024年），一次与新人安东内利搭档（2025年），但今年要想再次做到这一点，他需要重大逆转，因为赛历上还剩九场比赛。
罗斯伯格相信，勤奋的拉塞尔会继续努力，在W17赛车上找到突破，尽管他说这位28岁的车手不可避免地也会自我怀疑。
“我对乔治的方式印象深刻，因为他确实是个完美主义者，他试图涵盖人类表现的每一个方面，”这位天空体育 F1评论员补充道。
“我知道他在竭尽所能，我钦佩这一点。
“但正因如此，这对他更难，因为他自己也不理解。他一直很快；他一直至少与队友持平，突然之间这在他那里消失了。
“这真的很痛苦，因为你开始怀疑自己。无论你多么自信，然后就会[质疑]‘我是不是不够好？我过去是不是更好，而现在只是做错了什么？’这真的很难。”
天空体育 News的克雷格·斯莱特回顾西班牙大奖赛后的所有重大话题
“实际上我不在争夺中”——拉塞尔几乎排除车手冠军可能
就在前一周在蒙扎被安东内利夺走胜利（尽管队友因罚退从第19位发车）而落后66分之后，拉塞尔在进入西班牙大奖赛周末时承认，他今年要实现冠军梦“需要一些运气”。
在马德里赛道对他而言令人失望的周末，这一差距扩大到赛季最高的81分，这个周末因排位赛Q3的困难以及正赛中早早出现的虚拟安全车而受到影响。这一结果导致拉塞尔在周日晚上几乎将自己排除在争夺之外。
在评估自己对即将到来的比赛（从9月24日至26日的阿塞拜疆大奖赛开始）的策略时，拉塞尔告诉F1：“继续推进。尽管今天的成绩远非理想，但最近几场比赛更为积极。
“但这差不多就是本赛季的写照。我只需要专注于表现，继续努力帮助车队。
“我们显然处于赢得车队冠军的有利位置，实际上我已不在车手冠军的争夺中，这让我能够只专注于一场一场地比赛，努力专注于取得一些好成绩。”
梅赛德斯副领队布拉德利·洛德和乔治·拉塞尔讨论车队如何通过青训项目支持年轻人才，并资助基层可持续燃料项目
“我们只需把它释放出来”——沃尔夫支持“顶级车手”拉塞尔找到突破
他的梅赛德斯车队仍然相信拉塞尔会找回最佳状态。
当被问及拉塞尔目前最艰难地在为什么而战时，梅赛德斯车队领队托托·沃尔夫说：“我不知道，因为你能看到他在最后追赶勒克莱尔时的速度。他是赛道上最快的。
“但在换胎之后，速度就不在了。
“我就是不知道它在哪里，我们必须分析，因为显然它就在他身上，就在车里，我们只需把它释放出来。”

Nico Rosberg believes George Russell will currently be driven by a similar level of "insane motivation" to turn the tables on Kimi Antonelli as he was to get the better of Lewis Hamilton after recurring defeats.
Russell's hopes of becoming world champion for the first time this year are increasingly slim with in-form Mercedes team-mate Antonelli opening an 81-point lead over him at the top of the standings.

Since winning March's season-opening Australian Grand Prix, pre-season title favourite Russell has only twice finished ahead of Antonelli in the last 10 races they have both completed with the Briton seeing the young Italian take his seventh and eighth wins of the season across the Monza-Madrid double header.

Rosberg was asked after Sunday's race, in which Russell finished fifth, on Sky Sports F1 about his experience of rebounding to win his world title in 2016 after being soundly beaten to the crown by Mercedes team-mate Hamilton the year before.
"I was driven a lot by the pain," recalled Rosberg.
"Subjectively, it was painful to keep losing against Lewis and that just drove an insane motivation.
"George will be in a similar situation. He will be so damn motivated at the moment to try and find improvements.
"He'll be working so hard because I know George doesn't give up and he's hating the situation of getting beaten over and over by Kimi.
"He'll be working super hard but it's a bit of a difficult one because it's hard to understand where the pace has gone for him."

Russell has been Mercedes' top-scoring driver in three of his previous four seasons at the team, twice in three years against Hamilton (2022 and 2024) and once alongside a rookie Antonelli (2025), but he requires a major turnaround for that to be the case again this year with nine scheduled races left.
Rosberg believes the diligent Russell will keep working away to find a breakthrough with the W17 car, although says it is inevitable that the 28-year-old will be questioning himself too.
"I'm very impressed with George's approach because he's really a perfectionist and he tries to cover every aspect of his human performance," added the Sky Sports F1 pundit.
"I know he's doing everything he can, and I admire that.
"But, all the more, it's tough for him because he doesn't understand himself. He's always been fast; he's always been at least level with his team-mate and suddenly it's gone away from him there.

"It's really painful because you start to doubt yourself. It doesn't matter how confident you are, it then comes [to questioning] 'am I not good enough? Was I better in the past and I'm just doing something wrong now?' It's really difficult."

Fresh from being beaten to victory by Antonelli the weekend before at Monza despite his team-mate starting a penalised 19th on the grid to fall 66 points off the pace, Russell conceded going into the Spanish Grand Prix weekend that he would "need some luck" to realise his title dreams this year.

That deficit grew to a season-high 81 points in a disappointing weekend for him at the Madring, which was compromised by a difficult Q3 in qualifying and then an early Virtual Safety Car in the race. That result led to Russell all but ruling himself out of contention on Sunday evening.

Assessing his approach for the forthcoming races, starting with the Azerbaijan Grand Prix on September 24-26, Russell told F1: "Just keep pushing along. It has been a more positive couple of races even though the result was far from great today.
"But it's kind of story of the season. I just need to focus on the performance, keep trying to help the team.

"We're obviously in a great place to win the constructors', realistically I'm not in the fight for the drivers', and that just allows me just to focus on race-by-race and trying to focus on getting some good results."

'We just have to unlock it' - Wolff backing 'top driver' Russell to find breakthrough
His Mercedes team remain convinced Russell will rediscover his best form.

Asked what Russell was fighting hardest at the moment, Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff said: "I don't know, because you can see the pace he had towards the end when he was catching Leclerc. He was fastest out on track.
"But after the tyre changes, the pace wasn't there.
"I just don't know where it is and we have to analyse it, because clearly it's in him, it's in the car, and we just have to unlock it."

detailZh: F1修复马德里赛道、迎接明年西班牙大奖赛的五种方法
马德里赛道的首次F1亮相或许在赛场之外取得了成功，但比赛中缺乏精彩对抗，招致了大量批评，也为明年的西班牙大奖赛留下了许多反馈
备受期待的F1重返马德里因比赛缺乏精彩对抗而让车迷们感到意犹未尽，不过马德里赛道本身举办了一场相当体面的赛事。以下是主办方在第二年改进这项赛事的五种方法
总体而言，作为一场首次举办的赛事，马德里45年来的首场F1比赛进行得相当顺利。主办方计划充分利用IFEMA会展中心现有的设施，以及其便捷的公共交通和巴拉哈斯国际机场的交通条件
初步迹象表明，这项计划执行得相当不错，在一座城市中心举办的大型观赛活动中，几乎没有出现通常伴随而来的种种糟糕情况。除了要应付少数过于严苛的保安或警察之外，可容纳11万人的观众进出场地都相当顺畅。
但F1首先是一项赛车运动，因此马德里赛道最需要做好的核心项目就是赛道上的比赛产品。而这方面却差强人意。虽然排位赛颇具观赏性，但这条5.4公里长的赛道尽管是从一张白纸全新设计而来，却完全没有提供任何超车机会。
车手们对超车机会的匮乏感到不满。
马德里赛道之所以呈现如今的面貌，有很多原因。围绕展览馆群的南部区域天然受限，因为必须绕行现有的高大展览大厅。北部专门建造的部分虽然是全新设计，但IFEMA主办方考虑到未来的展馆和展览会，只能使用空地的其中一部分。再加上层层叠叠的官僚程序，建造一条城市赛道绝非易事。
但这并不能成为最终交付的这条赛道的借口。正如一位车手在看到设计的早期效果图时所说的那样：“这里根本不可能有超车。”
在赛事主办方和国际汽联着手为未来进行改进之际，以下是针对2027年改进这条赛道的五条建议。
马德里赛道最令人恼火的一点，是它坚持采用合并式弯道入口，车手必须在刹车的同时转向，两种作用力争夺轮胎有限的抓地力。这使得某些弯道非常别扭，也让前车很容易防守。
5号弯是最严重的问题，因为从图纸上来看，它是唯一一处能够真正自然发生超车的地方——它紧跟在第一个弯道组合之后最长的一段全油门直路之后。
但除了车辆并线入弯外，这个弯道宽度不足、路肩很高、紧贴护栏，这意味着想要超车几乎没有现实的可能，除非冒着被挤上护栏或被迫驶入沥青缓冲区的风险。
除了摩纳哥之外，大多数其他街道赛道至少都有一个超车机会。马德里赛道的弯道设计扼杀了这一点，据了解，根据车手和国际汽联的反馈，5号弯是2027年将进行重大改造的弯道之一。
狭窄而别扭的减速弯让超车几乎不可能。
营销宣传理所当然地聚焦于“纪念碑弯”，也就是12号弯那宏伟的倾斜弯道，它在F1赛历上是独一无二的。它在电视上看起来还不错，但远远没有体现出它的震撼。自由练习时站在环形弯的内侧，是赛历上最好的现场观赛体验之一，因为这个弯道拥有众多的横坡、半径和高度变化，使它有别于椭圆形赛道那种单一的倾斜弯道。
不过，主办方认为赛车在那里可以走不同线路的想法相当乐观，这个弯本身对比赛产品也没有增加多少价值。紧随其后的一段蛇形路段更是雪上加霜。13号弯是另一个90度的中速弯，护栏位置很别扭，导致完全无法超车。16号弯又是一个组合入口，而在最后几个通往终点大直道的弯角里，赛车只能排成纵队通过。
兰多·诺里斯建议绕过18号和19号弯，打造第二条长直道，然后在20号弯接一个发夹弯，并加宽弯道设计以允许不同的走线，或许还可以增加一些倾角。这还需要重新调整出口处的护栏，因为它们令人恼火地侵占了赛车线。
IFEMA作为场地的一大优势同时也是某种弱点。这个地方太庞大了。这让车队更方便运入和运出物资，给了他们充足的工作空间，甚至未来几年还可以增加其他活动——这些活动在其他地方根本不会有足够的空间。
但在场地内走动非常麻烦，尤其对像迈凯伦这样位于维修区尽头、工程区和接待区之间距离巨大的车队来说更是如此。这让公关团队整个周末都变成了高尔夫球车司机，但并非人人都有车接送。希望这个场地的巨大面积不只是被用来塞进更多贵宾和名人——周日的情形已经给人这种感觉了。
IFEMA场地过于庞大在赛道上也带来了后果。540米长的维修区通道不仅特别长，而且由于既有建筑的限制，中间还设有一段100米的分隔。
由于这场比赛演变成了一场相对简单的一停战术，如此漫长的维修区通道只会进一步打消车队尝试其他策略的念头。当超车几乎不可能时，策略上的差异是唯一能引发超车或为比赛增添看点的方式——除非寄希望于红旗和安全车。
尽管马德里展馆区域是一个极具特色的地标，但赛道其余部分却让人感觉可以位于世界上任何地方。
前车手、如今的评论员兼赛道设计师亚历山大·伍尔兹的说明最为到位。“当我看着这些混凝土通道时，有时候我甚至不知道自己身处哪条街道赛道，”伍尔兹对奥地利广播电台（ORF）说。“我是在澳大利亚，是在瓦伦西亚，还是在马德里？我到底在哪里？
“它们看起来总是千篇一律。这意味着我没能在这么酷的场合代表我的主办城市。其实有很多可以发挥的空间。”
虽然令人心跳加速的拉蒙特门塔尔大弯道是一次成功的加入，但马德里赛道的许多区域看起来毫无特色。
放大视角的转播镜头让马德里赛道的情况雪上加霜，而且要让围绕混凝土展览馆的 比赛（比赛）看起来有吸引力本来就很困难。但一定有办法让人们感觉身处于马德里。否则，这一切的意义何在？
还需要更加用心地改善观众的视线，因为我们收到了大量车迷的投诉：由于混凝土护栏的摆放位置，他们坐在昂贵的大看台座位上却被挡住看不到赛车。这个问题对于明年来说相对容易解决，但遗憾的是起初没能避免。
对马德里赛道来说，最重要的事情是体面地度过第一年。组织方在时间安排上面临很大压力，因此重点放在做好充分准备、为观众提供顺畅且安全的体验上。随着首秀顺利完成，马德里赛道可以开始思考如何整体提升车迷体验。
一些车迷区和普通入场区域看起来空荡荡的，细节也比较粗糙。设计方仿照了蒙扎那种俯瞰主直道的大型颁奖台，但没有能力或信心允许车迷像典型的意大利大奖赛那样冲进赛道、真正参与到庆祝之中。正如其他分站发生的意外所表明的，冲进赛道并不容易保障安全，所以第一年组织方保持谨慎是可以理解的。
只有少数车迷能够参与颁奖台庆祝活动，因为组织方在第一年选择了稳妥行事。
无论是在赛道上还是赛道外，马德里赛道都有很多机会提升自己的水准，而为期10年的合同也给了它足够的喘息空间，让它有望成为赛历上深受喜爱的组成部分。
“这只是第一步，”赛事常务董事路易斯·加西亚·阿巴德在比赛结束后接受Motorsport.com采访时说道。“我们在观众和接待方面取得了巨大成功，现在我们对未来几年有很多想法。”
“我们有空间，有场地，有设施，也有能力做到这一点。我相信一级方程式管理公司、国际汽联和我们自己都会去努力。如果有什么可以改进的地方，我们就会去做。”
detailEn: Five ways F1 can fix the Madring for next year's Spanish GP
The Madring's Formula 1 debut may have been an off-track success, but its lack of action has triggered plenty of criticism and feedback for next year's Spanish Grand Prix

F1's much-anticipated return to Madrid has left fans of the series wanting due to a lack of action, though the Madring venue itself put on a respectable event. Here are five ways organisers could improve the event for year two.

By and large, Madrid's first F1 race in 45 years ran particularly smooth for a first-time event. The organisers planned to capitalise on the IFEMA fairgrounds' existing facilities and their easy access to public transportation and to the Barajas International Airport.

Early indications are that that plan worked rather well, with few if any of the typical horror stories accompanying a mass spectator event in the middle of a city. Other than dealing with a few overzealous security guards or police officers, the 110,000 capacity crowd was able to get in and out of the venue rather smoothly.

But F1 is a motor race first and foremost, so the biggest ticket item the Madring needed to get right was its on-track product. It left a lot to be desired. While qualifying was an enticing spectacle, the 5.4km circuit offered zero overtaking opportunities despite being drawn up from a blank sheet of paper.
Drivers were left unimpressed with the lack of overtaking opportunities.

There are plenty of reasons why the Madring circuit is the way it is. The southern part around the complex is inherently limited because of the existing, towering exhibition halls which need navigating around. The northern, purpose-built part was a blank sheet design, but IFEMA organisers could only use a part of the empty plot of land of the track with future pavilions and expositions in mind. Add in the layers of bureaucracy involved, and building an urban race circuit is no easy feat.
But that's no excuse for the circuit that was eventually delivered. As one racing driver put it when he saw an early mock-up of the design: "There's not going to be any overtaking here."
As organisers and the FIA work on improvements for the future, here are five suggestions to improve the venue for 2027.

The most annoying aspect of the Madring was its insistence on drawing combined corner entries, where drivers have to brake and steer at the same time, both forces competing for a limited amount of tyre grip. It made certain corners very awkward and also made it easy for the car in front to defend.
Turn 5 is the worst offender, because on paper it was the only spot where overtaking could actually happen organically, following the longest flat/out section coming out of the first corner sequence.

But alongside the combined entry, the corner's lack of width, presence of high kerbs and proximity of the walls meant there was no realistic way to pass without risking being put into the wall or forced through the asphalt runoff area.

Other than Monaco, most other street circuits feature at least one passing opportunity. Madrid's corner design thwarted that, and it is understood Turn 5 is one of the corner that will undergo significant changes for 2027 following feedback by the drivers and the FIA.
Narrow, awkward chicanes made overtaking all but impossible.

Marketing efforts understandably focused on La Monumental, the majestic banking in Turn 12 which is unique on the F1 calendar. It looked okay on TV, but that didn't nearly do it justice. Standing on the inside of the loop in free practice was one of the better trackside thrills on the calendar because of the corner's many camber, radius and elevation changes that set it apart from an oval-style baking.

Organisers were rather optimistic to think that cars could take different lines through there, though, and the corner didn't add much value to the racing product itself. Its cause wasn't helped by the snaking section that followed. Turn 13 was another 90-degree medium-speed corner with awkward barrier placement that didn't allow for any passing. Turn 16 had another combined entry, while it was single-file through the final few corners towards the finish straight.

Lando Norris suggested a bypass of Turns 18 and 19 to create a second long straight followed by a hairpin in Turn 20, widening its design to allow different approaches, perhaps adding some camber, too. That would also involve realigning the exit barriers, as they annoyingly encroached on the racing line.

One of IFEMA's biggest advantages as a venue was also somewhat of a weakness. The place is enormous. That made it easier for teams to ship freight in and out and gave them plenty of space to work, and perhaps even add other activities in following years that they would never have the space for elsewhere.

But getting around was cumbersome, especially for a team like McLaren which was at the far end of the pitlane, creating a massive distance between its engineering hubs and hospitality units. It turned PR teams into golf car drivers for the weekend, but not everyone was as lucky to be ferried around. Hopefully the ground's massive size isn't just used to cram even more VIPs and celebrities into the venue, which already felt the case on Sunday.
There's also an on-track consequence to IFEMA's vast size. The 540-metre pitlane was not only particularly long, but also featured a 100-metre split in the middle dictated by existing buildings.

With the race turning into a relatively straightforward one-stopper, having such a long pitlane only further discouraged teams from attempting alternative strategies. When overtaking is almost impossible, strategic variance is the only way to induce it or otherwise spice up the race - short of hoping for red flags and safety cars.
As much as La Monumental was a distinctive landmark, the rest of the circuit felt like it could have been anywhere in the world.

Former driver and now pundit and track designer Alex Wurz explained it best. "When I look at this concrete channel, at some point I wouldn't know which street circuit I'm on anymore," Wurz told ORF. "Am I in Australia, am I in Valencia, am I in Madrid, where am I?
"They all always look the same. That means I'm not representing my host city in such a cool way. There's quite a lot you could do there."
While the hair-raising La Monumental banking was a successful addition, many areas of the Madring circuit looked nondescript.

The Madring's case wasn't helped by the zoomed-in viewing angles and it was always going to be tricky to make racing around concrete exhibition halls look attractive. But there has to be a way to make people feel they are in Madrid. Otherwise, what is the point?

More care also needs to be taken to improve sightlines for spectators, as we received plenty of complaints from fans being blocked from seeing the cars from their expensive grandstand seats because of the concrete barrier placement. That's an issue that's relatively straightforward to resolve for next year, but it's a shame it couldn't have been prevented to begin with.

For Madrid, the most important thing was to get through year one respectably. The organisers were up against it in terms of timelines, so the focus was on being ready to provide a smooth and safe experience. With its debut out of the way, the Madring can start thinking about elevating the fan experience in general.

Some fan zones and general admission areas looked sparse and rough around the edges. Designers copied Monza's sprawling podium overlooking the main straight, but weren't able or confident to allow for a typical Italian GP style track invasion for fans to actually be part of the celebration. As shown by incidents at other races, a track invasion is not easy to pull off, so it's understandable why organisers have been prudent in year one.
Only few fans were able to take part in the podium celebrations as organisers played it safe in year one.

Both on and off the track, there are plenty of opportunities for the Madring to step up its game, and its 10-year contract is giving it the breathing room to do so and become a beloved part of the calendar.

"This is the first step," the race's managing director Luis Garcia Abad told Motorsport.com after the race. "We had a big success in terms of public and hospitality, and now we have a lot of ideas for the next few years.
"We have the space, we have a venue, we have the facilities, we have the capacity to do it. I'm sure that FOM, FIA, and ourselves, we will try. If we can improve something, we will do it."

拉塞尔是顶级车队中唯一没有在马德里这条超车极其困难的赛道上坚持一停策略的车手，这主要与VSC介入的时机有关。
赛会控制中心在第14圈结束时中和了比赛，这有利于以中性胎或软胎起步的前四名车手——除了兰多·诺里斯，他在VSC宣布时已经通过了维修区入口。
然而，查尔斯·勒克莱尔和拉塞尔等人以硬胎起步。勒克莱尔留在赛道上并领跑至第45圈进站，而梅赛德斯车手在VSC下换上了中性胎，然后在第28圈换回硬胎。
与此同时，梅赛德斯队友兼积分榜领先者基米·安东内利在VSC时机有利、杆位得主诺里斯被排除后获胜。
“VSC对乔治的作用非常不同，它出现在对他最糟糕的时刻，因为他以硬胎起步，本打算跑长距离并利用比赛后期的任何事件，”洛德详细说道。
“他以第6位硬胎起步进入比赛，计划一停。当VSC出动时，他是硬胎中仅次于勒克莱尔法拉利的第二辆车。因此我们叫乔治‘与勒克莱尔相反地进站’。
“为什么？因为如果我们不这样做，他就会简单地跟随勒克莱尔到终点。提前进站的机会非常非常有限，而对于轮胎年龄相近的赛车来说，超车的机会几乎不存在。
“所以我们让乔治换上了中性胎。我们知道中性胎无法跑完剩余的43圈，但通过做一些不同的事情——乔治跑了20圈，然后我们换回硬胎，因为你希望尽可能多地在比赛中使用硬胎。
“乔治随后展现了非常令人印象深刻的表现。他足够快，实际上把勒克莱尔拖进了维修区，可能比法拉利希望的要早，这样把勒克莱尔拖了进来，给了基米前方的干净空气，但随后乔治在最后几圈用相当脆弱的软胎向勒克莱尔施压，最终以仅落后0.7秒完赛。
“赛后乔治非常务实，他说他并不认为我们做什么会有区别，无论是让他留在外面还是进站，鉴于在马德里超车的难度，他很可能总是以第5名完赛。”
尽管以0.4秒的优势做出最快圈速，拉塞尔的低排名结果再次打击了他的冠军希望。这位英国人现在落后安东内利81分，并公开表示他“极不可能”甚至争夺冠军。
detailEn: Mercedes explains why George Russell pitted under VSC at Madring
The timing of the VSC was highly detrimental to Russell’s race in Madrid, and it was perhaps surprising for him to pit then; Mercedes has expanded on its strategy call
Mercedes deputy team principal Bradley Lord has explained why George Russell pitted under the virtual safety car despite starting on hard tyres in Formula 1’s Spanish Grand Prix.
Russell was the only driver from the top teams not to stick to a one-stop on a Madring track where overtaking was at a premium, which was largely down to the timing of the VSC intervention.

Race control neutralised the race at the end of lap 14, which played into the hands of the top four drivers, who started on medium or soft tyres – except Lando Norris, who was already past the pitlane entry when the VSC was announced.

The likes of Charles Leclerc and Russell, however, started the race on the hard compound. Leclerc stayed out and led the race until his lap-45 pitstop, while the Mercedes driver switched to mediums under the VSC and then back to hards on lap 28.
Meanwhile, Mercedes team-mate and championship leader Kimi Antonelli triumphed after the fortunate timing of the neutralisation took polesitter Norris out of his way.

“The VSC worked very differently for George, it fell at the worst possible time for him given that he'd started the race on hards and was looking to run long and capitalise on any events later in the race,” Lord detailed.

“He headed into the race starting on the hard tyre from P6 with a plan to do a one-stop. When the VSC came out he was the second car running on the hard tyre behind Leclerc's Ferrari. Therefore we called for George to do a ‘box opposite to Leclerc’.

“Why? Because had we not done so he would have simply followed Leclerc to the finish. The opportunity to undercut was very, very limited, and the opportunity to overtake was almost non-existent for cars on similar age tyres.

“So we put George onto the medium. We knew that medium wasn't going to be able to do 43 laps to the end, but in doing something different – so George did a 20-lap stint, and then we jumped back onto the hard tyre, because you wanted to be on that hard tyre for as much of the race as possible.

“George then unleashed some really impressive performance. He was going quick enough that he actually pulled Leclerc into the pits probably earlier than Ferrari had wanted to and so that pulled Leclerc in, gave Kimi the free air up front but also then George was pressuring Leclerc in those final laps on that soft tyre that was quite fragile, and actually ended the race only 0.7 seconds behind.

“After the race George was very pragmatic, he said he didn't really think it mattered what we'd have done, whether we'd have left him out or boxed him, he was always likely to finish in P5 given the difficulty of overtaking at the Madring.”

Despite setting the fastest lap by four tenths, Russell’s lowly result was another blow to his championship hopes. The Briton now lies 81 points adrift of Antonelli and openly feels “exceptionally unlikely” to even fight for the title.

items.summaryEn: The Race Of Champions has announced the first four drivers for its inaugural New Zealand event, led by four-time Formula 1 world champion Sebastian Vettel, taking place at Wellington's Hnry Stadium on 9-10 January 2027.
detailZh: F1世界冠军领衔车王争霸赛新西兰首站车手阵容
2027年车王争霸赛公布首批四位车手
车王争霸赛公布了其新西兰首站的首批四位车手，该赛事将于2027年1月9日至10日在惠灵顿的Hnry Stadium举行。
阵容由四届F1世界冠军塞巴斯蒂安·维特尔领衔，自2007年以来他仅缺席过两届车王争霸赛。这位德国车手曾与迈克尔·舒马赫搭档，在2007年至2012年连续六年赢得国家杯，并于2017年与帕斯卡尔·维尔莱茵搭档再次夺冠；他还在2015年伦敦的正赛中获胜。
“在悉尼车王争霸赛之前，我第一次快速访问了新西兰，被这个国家的美丽所震撼，所以我开玩笑地对组织者说，‘你们能不能把下一届车王争霸赛带到新西兰来？’”维特尔说。“我真的很期待在一月份于惠灵顿举行的车王争霸赛中与来自全球的众多其他冠军同场竞技，并有机会游览更多新西兰的地方。”
一位现役F1车手也已公布，那就是瓦尔特利·博塔斯；这位十次大奖赛冠军得主，目前效力于垫底的凯迪拉克车队，将第三次参加该赛事。
海登·帕顿，现代世界拉力车队的现代i20 N Rally1赛车
其他系列赛也将有代表参加，包括2025年Supercars冠军查兹·莫斯特，他在去年于澳大利亚举行的上一届车王争霸赛中完成了首秀，以及新西兰明星海登·帕顿，他曾一次赢得WRC分站冠军。
“看到世界上最具观赏性的赛车运动赛事之一首次来到新西兰，真是太棒了，”帕顿说。“新西兰目前在许多领域都处于赛车运动的黄金时代，我想不出比举办车王争霸赛更合适的庆祝方式了，它吸引了来自世界各地的众多大牌明星。
“对于新西兰赛车迷来说，这真是一个千载难逢的机会，可以近距离接触来自F1、WRC、场地赛和其他赛车形式的车手，他们将在新西兰最著名的体育场馆之一内驾驶同等赛车展开较量。由于诸多原因，这确实是一场历史性的赛事，我个人非常自豪能参与其中。”
detailEn: F1 world champion among drivers for Race Of Champions’ first New Zealand event
The first four drivers for the 2027 ROC have been announced
The Race Of Champions has announced the first four drivers for its inaugural New Zealand event, taking place at Wellington’s Hnry Stadium on 9-10 January 2027.

The lineup will be spearheaded by four-time Formula 1 world champion Sebastian Vettel, who has taken part in all but two Race Of Champions events since 2007. The German won the Nations’ Cup six years in a row, from 2007 to 2012, alongside Michael Schumacher, and in 2017 with Pascal Wehrlein; he also triumphed in the main contest in London in 2015.

“Before ROC Sydney I went for a first quick visit to New Zealand and was blown away by the beauty of the country, so I told the organisers jokingly, ‘Can you please bring the next ROC to New Zealand?’,” Vettel said. “I am really looking forward to competing against so many other champions from across the globe at the Race Of Champions in Wellington in January, and getting a chance to visit more of New Zealand.”
A current F1 driver has also been announced in Valtteri Bottas; the 10-time grand prix winner, now racing for backmarker Cadillac, will take part in the event for just the third time.
Hayden Paddon, Hyundai World Rally Team Hyundai i20 N Rally1

Other series will also be represented with 2025 Supercars champion Chaz Mostert, who made his Race Of Champions debut last time out that same year in Australia, and New Zealand star Hayden Paddon, a one-time WRC rally winner.

“It’s amazing to see one of the world’s most spectacular motorsport events come to New Zealand for the first time ever,” Paddon said. “New Zealand is really in a golden age of motorsport at the moment across so many disciplines, and I can’t think of a more fitting celebration of this than hosting the Race Of Champions, that attracts so many of the biggest stars from all around the world.

“This is really a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity for Kiwi motorsport fans to get up close and personal with drivers from F1, WRC, circuit and other motorsport forms, all battling it out in equal machinery inside one of New Zealand’s most famous sports stadiums. It’s really a historic event for so many reasons, and I’m personally incredibly proud to be a part of it.”

items.originalTitle: 奥迪首位F1青训车手斯莱特2027年加盟Invicta征战F2
items.summaryEn: Audi's first Formula 1 junior driver Freddie Slater will join defending champion team Invicta in Formula 2 in 2027.
detailZh: 奥迪首位F1青训车手Freddie Slater将于2027年加入F2卫冕冠军车队Invicta，征战Formula 2。
斯莱特上周末在马德里环道（马德里赛道）与F3冠军失之交臂，但他度过了一个令人印象深刻的菜鸟赛季，兑现了他在卡丁车赛场的强劲表现以及意大利F4和欧洲区域方程式背靠背夺冠所积累的潜力。
正是这些早期职业生涯的成功，意味着他从小就收到了多支F1车队邀请他加入其青训计划的报价。
但就像维斯塔潘和诺里斯一样，斯莱特和他的管理团队没有过早接受这些报价。
今年年初，他接受了奥迪的提议，成为奥迪在2026年进入F1时首位加入其F1车手发展计划的车手。
斯莱特以14分之差无缘F3冠军，他在蒙扎正赛遭遇代价高昂的机械故障，马德里收官战又经历噩梦般的表现，让主要对手Ugo Ugochukwu夺得了冠军。
斯莱特现在将随Invicta升入F2，这支车队在过去两年连续实现年度双冠，奥迪F1车手博托莱托和迈凯伦储备车手Leonardo Fornaroli最近两年分别随该队夺得车手冠军。Bortoleto和Fornaroli也都是从Trident的F3车队转投Invicta的F2车队，正如斯莱特将要走的路一样。
Invicta目前希望今年凭借法拉利青训车手Rafael Camara实现F2三连冠，后者目前落后积分榜领跑者Nikola Tsolov七分。Invicta车队本身在车队积分榜上也仅落后Campos六分。
F2在下一轮巴库站增加了一场正赛，原因是目前卡塔尔和阿布扎比最后两轮比赛存在不确定性。
斯莱特将在阿布扎比季后测试中首次亮相，但如果F1如预期取消卡塔尔和阿布扎比周末，这一测试很可能需要改期。如果F2决定像目前后备计划那样于12月在伊莫拉举行赛季收官战，F2可能会与F1一同前往。按理说，F2季后测试也将在此举行。
“升入F2对Freddie来说是自然的下一步，也是他车手发展的重要新阶段，”奥迪车手发展总监Allan McNish表示。
“他度过了一个强劲的F3赛季，一直争夺冠军到最后一轮——全年展现了他的速度、比赛能力和进步。”
“我们为Freddie本赛季取得的成就以及一路以来的成长感到非常自豪。Invicta 比赛近年来有着出色的战绩，我们很高兴能与他们合作。”
“我们相信这是他的理想环境，期待在他2027年迎接新挑战时继续支持他。”
在F2现行赛车的三年里，Invicta一直是明显的标杆车队，但该赛事将从2027年起引入大幅改版的赛车。
斯莱特出席了新赛车在蒙扎的发布活动，他告诉The 比赛：“我觉得它太棒了。我觉得非常令人兴奋。”
“显然F1今年变化很大，所以F2也需要跟进，才能在这条晋升阶梯上继续进步。”
“所以我很兴奋能有机会驾驶一辆，看看它的表现会非常有趣。”
斯莱特是首位确认的2027年F2车手，但预计还会有多位F3对手加入，包括冠军Ugochukwu。
F3年度亚军以及F4和FREC冠军头衔意味着，尚未驾驶过F1赛车的斯莱特拥有足够积分，远超F1超级驾照所需的40分门槛。
detailEn: Audi's first Formula 1 junior driver Freddie Slater will join forces with defending champion team Invicta in Formula 2 in 2027.

Slater narrowly missed out on the Formula 3 title at the Madring last weekend but has had a highly impressive rookie season, living up to the promise built up by strong karting success and back-to-back titles in Italian Formula 4 and the Formula Regional European Championship.
It was that early-career success that meant he had offers from multiple F1 teams to join their junior programmes from an early age.
But much like Max Verstappen and Lando Norris, Slater and his management team held off on accepting those offers too early.
At the start of this year, he accepted Audi's proposal for him to become the first driver to join its F1 driver development programme as it entered F1 in 2026.

Slater fell 14 points short of winning the F3 title, having suffered a costly mechanical failure in the Monza feature race and a nightmare Madrid title-decider that allowed chief rival Ugo Ugochukwu to take the crown instead.

Slater will now move up to F2 with Invicta, the team that has taken back-to-back championship doubles in the last two years, with Audi F1 driver Gabriel Bortoleto and McLaren reserve driver Leonardo Fornaroli taking the last two drivers’ titles with it. Bortoleto and Fornaroli both also went from Trident's F3 team to Invicta's F2 team, just as Slater will.

Invicta is currently hoping to make it three out of three F2 titles this year with Ferrari junior Rafael Camara, who is seven points adrift of championship leader Nikola Tsolov. Invicta itself is also just six points off Campos in the teams' title race.
F2 has added an extra feature race to its next round in Baku amid uncertainty over its current final two rounds in Qatar and Abu Dhabi.

Slater is set to make his debut in the post-season Abu Dhabi test, although this will likely have to be rescheduled if F1 cancels its Qatar and Abu Dhabi weekends as expected. F2 could decide to join F1 if it holds its season finale at Imola in December, as is the current back-up plan. Logically the post-season F2 test would also be held there.
"The move to Formula 2 is the natural next step for Freddie, and an important new phase of his development as a driver," Audi's driver development director Allan McNish said.
"He enjoyed a strong Formula 3 season, fighting for the title until the final round - showing his speed, racecraft and progress throughout the year.

"We are very proud of what Freddie has achieved this season and how he has developed along the way. Invicta Racing has had an excellent record in recent years, and we are delighted to be working with them.
"We believe it is the ideal environment for him, and we look forward to supporting him as he takes on this new challenge in 2027."
Invicta has been the clear benchmark team during the three years of F2's current car, but the series is introducing a heavily revised version of the car from 2027.
Slater was present at the launch of the new car at Monza, telling The Race: "I think it's mega. I think it's very exciting.
"Obviously F1 has changed a lot this year so F2 kind of needs to follow suit to progress to that ladder.
"So I'm very excited to get a go behind the wheel of one and it's going to be very interesting to see what it performs like."
Slater is the first confirmed 2027 F2 driver, but he’s expected to be joined by a number of his F3 rivals, including champion Ugochukwu.
A second-place championship finish in F3 and titles in F4 and FREC mean Slater, who is yet to drive an F1 car, has more than enough points to clear the 40-point threshold for an F1 superlicence.

Invicta过去两年在F2实现车手和车队双冠，此前两届车手冠军博托莱托和Leonardo Fornaroli均从Trident的F3车队转投Invicta的F2车队，与斯莱特路径相同。

连续四场正赛登上领奖台，使斯莱特在进入夏休期前从二年级车手乌戈·乌戈丘库手中夺走积分榜领先位置，但他在赛季最后五场比赛中仅再得15分，最终在冠军争夺中被这位Campos车手超越。
斯莱特仍是本赛季最佳新秀——尽管他曾在2025年参加过两站比赛。八个领奖台（包括匈牙利站一胜）意味着这位18岁的英国车手轻松获得年度亚军，领先二年级车手图卡·塔波宁和同为一年级新秀的加藤大翔。
“我非常兴奋明年能随Invicta 比赛升入F2，”斯莱特说。“本赛季我在F3学到了很多，我觉得自己在这一年中作为车手和个人都有所成长。”
“Invicta在F2有着出色的战绩，我迫不及待想与车队开始合作，共同备战我们的赛季。我也非常感谢奥迪车手发展计划一直以来的支持。我还有很多东西要学，我非常期待迎接这一新挑战。”
近年来，Trident到Invicta的输送通道极为成功，多次出现连续夺冠的情况。
加布里埃尔·博尔托莱托、莱昂纳多·福纳罗利和拉斐尔·卡马拉随这支意大利车队赢得了此前三个F3年度冠军，随后转投这支位于诺福克的车队征战F2——其中博尔托莱托和福纳罗利在F2首个赛季便成为冠军。目前卡马拉在2026赛季积分榜上紧随第二名，很有机会复制他们的成就。
尽管斯莱特在F3中惜败未能夺冠，但这些正是他2027年力争效仿的榜样。
“升入F2对弗雷迪来说是自然的下一步，也是他作为车手发展的重要新阶段，”奥迪车手发展计划总监艾伦·麦克尼什说。
“他度过了一个强劲的F3赛季，一直争夺冠军到最后一场比赛——全年展现了他的速度、比赛能力和进步。我们为弗雷迪本赛季取得的成就以及他一路走来的成长感到非常自豪。
“Invicta 比赛近年来战绩出色，我们很高兴能与他们合作。我们相信这是他的理想环境，并期待在他2027年迎接这一新挑战时给予支持。”
detailEn: Audi F1 junior Freddie Slater signs F2 deal for 2027 season
Audi junior Slater will step up with Invicta Racing after a successful 2026 campaign at Trident
Formula 3 runner-up and Audi Formula 1 junior Freddie Slater will step up to Formula 2 with Invicta Racing in 2027.
The 2024 Italian F4 and 2025 Formula Regional European champion was signed by Audi to spearhead its new Driver Development Programme in 2026, while he moved to F3 with Trident.

Four consecutive feature-race podiums meant Slater snatched the lead of the championship away from sophomore Ugo Ugochukwu going into the summer break, but he only scored 15 more points across the last five races of the season and was surpassed by the Campos driver in the title battle.

Slater still was the best rookie of the season – though he did take part in two rounds in 2025. Eight podiums including one victory in Hungary meant the 18-year-old Briton comfortably took the runner-up spot ahead of second-year Tuukka Taponen and fellow debutant Taito Kato.

“I’m really excited to be stepping up to Formula 2 with Invicta Racing next year,” Slater said. “I learned a lot in Formula 3 this season, and I feel I have developed as a driver and as a person over the course of the year.

“Invicta has a great record in Formula 2, and I cannot wait to get started with the team and prepare for our campaign together. I am also very grateful for the continued support from the Audi Driver Development Programme. There is still a lot for me to learn, and I’m really looking forward to taking on this new challenge.”
The Trident-to-Invicta pipeline has been extremely successful in recent years with several instances of back-to-back titles.

Gabriel Bortoleto, Leonardo Fornaroli and Rafael Camara earned the previous three F3 crowns with the Italian squad, before switching to the Norfolk-based outfit in F2 – where Bortoleto and Fornaroli became champions as rookies. Currently a close second in the 2026 standings, Camara has a decent chance of emulating them.
Even though he narrowly failed to prevail in F3, these are the examples Slater will aim to follow in 2027.
“The move to Formula 2 is the natural next step for Freddie, and an important new phase of his development as a driver,” said Audi Driver Development Programme director Allan McNish.

“He enjoyed a strong Formula 3 season, fighting for the title until the final round – showing his speed, racecraft and progress throughout the year. We are very proud of what Freddie has achieved this season and how he has developed along the way.

“Invicta Racing has had an excellent record in recent years, and we are delighted to be working with them. We believe it is the ideal environment for him, and we look forward to supporting him as he takes on this new challenge in 2027.”

detailZh: 红牛坚称伊萨克·哈贾尔的康复“没有任何问题”
哈贾尔目前已缺席三场大奖赛，但红牛坚持认为他的康复正按计划进行
红牛车队领队洛朗·梅基斯表示，伊萨克·哈贾尔的伤病恢复情况符合预期，尽管这位法国车手已缺席最近三场F1大奖赛。
哈贾尔在夏休期训练中手腕受伤，此后由利亚姆·劳森顶替其席位，而储备车手角田裕毅则在小红牛车队临时出战。
与七届MotoGP世界冠军马克·马奎斯的交流让这位法国二年级车手确信，他不应仓促复出。马奎斯在2020年赫雷斯揭幕战中肱骨骨折，试图参加下一场比赛，最终赛季报销。
在周日的西班牙大奖赛后被问及哈贾尔情况如何以及他参加巴库站比赛的几率时，梅基斯笑着说：“伊萨克很好，他现在就在楼下。玩笑归玩笑，伊萨克的康复没有任何问题。”
“我认为我们已经了解到，对于他这种伤病，这基本上是一个正常的时间，所以我们将继续沿用之前的做法。”
“我们将在一周后评估情况。我们有超过一整周的时间来评估情况，看看他的感觉，然后让他上模拟器，让他体验真实约束。”
“如果他感觉接近100%，我们就上；如果他觉得康复尚未完成，我们将坚持把康复放在首位的做法。我们不想做的是，因为过早复出而损害他长期恢复到100%的能力。”
与此同时，劳森将再次相当忙碌，因为这位新西兰人需要为两支车队备战下一场比赛，以应对哈贾尔情况的任何变化。
“在工厂待了很多时间，做了很多额外的准备工作，”劳森承认。“我觉得这周休息不会有多少休息。”
当被问及是否期待回到自己的赛车时，他澄清道：“我的意思是，更多是准备工作。为两支车队做备战有点困难，还要适应不同的赛车。”
“现在[马德里]周末接近尾声，我在这辆车里感觉相当舒服。但展望未来，直到比赛周末之前都是未知数。”
“可能直到巴库站的周三或周四才会决定，而在心理上准备我要驾驶哪辆车是相当棘手的。”
“但与此同时，就像我说的，我开这辆车的时间越多，就越舒服。现在换回去会相当艰难。驾驶起来完全不同。”
劳森在红牛的三场大奖赛中共获得14分，巩固了他在车手积分榜上第九的位置。他现在仅落后哈贾尔12分。

detailEn: Red Bull insists “there is nothing wrong” with Isack Hadjar's recovery
Hadjar has missed three grands prix by now, but Red Bull maintains his recovery is going to plan
Red Bull team principal Laurent Mekies says Isack Hadjar’s recovery from injury is on target, despite the Frenchman having missed the last three Formula 1 grands prix.
Hadjar injured his wrist in training during the summer break and has since been replaced by Liam Lawson, with reserve driver Yuki Tsunoda standing in at Racing Bulls.

Interaction with seven-time MotoGP world champion Marc Marquez, who infamously struggled with injury for years, convinced the French sophomore he shouldn’t rush his return to action. Marquez broke his humerus in the 2020 Jerez opener, tried to partake in the next race, and ended up sidelined for the remainder of the season.

Asked after Sunday’s Spanish Grand Prix how Hadjar was doing and what his odds to race in Baku were, Mekies smiled: “Isack is good, he's downstairs right now. Joke aside, there is nothing wrong with Isack's recovery.
“I think we have learned that it's fundamentally a normal time for the sort of injuries he has, so we will continue with the same approach than what we had.

“We will evaluate the situations in a week's time. We have a bit more than a full week to evaluate the situations, to see how he feels, and then to put him on the simulator, to expose him to real-life constraints.

“If he feels close to 100%, we go for it; if he feels the recovery is not completed, we will stick on our approach to put his recovery first. What we don't want to do is, by having an early return, compromise his long-term capacity to come back to 100%.”
In the meantime, Lawson will again be rather busy as the New Zealander is required to prepare for the next event with both teams, to account for any development in Hadjar’s situation.
“It's a lot of time at the factory and doing a lot of extra preparations,” Lawson admitted. “I think this week off won't be much of a week off.”
Asked if he was looking forward to getting back to his own car, he clarified: “I mean, it's more the prep. Doing prep for both is a bit difficult, and getting used to different cars.
“Coming to the end of the [Madrid] weekend now, I feel quite comfortable in this car. But just going forward, it's the unknown all the way up to the race weekends.
“Probably all the way up to Wednesday or Thursday for Baku will be, potentially, when that's decided, and that's quite tricky to mentally prepare for what car I'm going to drive.
“But, at the same time, like I said, the more time I drive this, I get more comfortable. Going back now will be quite tough. It's completely different to drive.”
Lawson has scored 14 points across his three grands prix at Red Bull, cementing his ninth position in the drivers’ standings. He’s now just 12 points adrift of Hadjar.

James Hinchcliffe 认为，在 诺里斯 展现出更强速度后，安东内利 的西班牙大奖赛胜利仍会让人感到刺痛

detailEn: Kimi Antonelli's Spanish GP win will still "sting", says James Hinchcliffe
James Hinchcliffe believes Kimi Antonelli’s Spanish Grand Prix victory will still sting after Lando Norris showed stronger pace

Mercedes driver and current championship leader Kimi Antonelli will feel a "sting" after his Spanish Grand Prix victory because he knows McLaren's Lando Norris had the faster car, according to former IndyCar Series driver and F1 TV analyst James Hinchcliffe.

Antonelli secured his eighth win of the 2026 Formula 1 season at the inaugural race at the Madring circuit, extending his lead in the standings to 81 points over his team-mate George Russell. But the Italian's win relied on a perfectly timed virtual safety car.

Norris, who had started from pole position, built a strong advantage over the chasing pack during the opening stint of the race. When the virtual safety car was deployed just after the McLaren driver passed the pitlane entry, Antonelli capitalised by taking a cheaper pitstop. Norris subsequently pitted as the virtual safety car ended, suffering a four-second stop.
Despite Antonelli executing a strong race to secure the win, Hinchcliffe argued that the pace of the Woking squad will frustrate the 20-year-old.
Lando Norris, McLaren, Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes

"I don't want to say it's better to be lucky than good, but sometimes it's good to be both because we know he's good. He's definitely good. But he had some luck and you even heard it in the post-race interview, he was like, 'Yeah, we'll take it,'" Hinchcliffe said of Antonelli's win during F1 TV's post-race broadcast.

"You guys know what it's like as a driver. Even when you win, when you know there was somebody faster than you, it still stings a little. You want to be the best driver on the day. And I don't think we can say that he was.

"He was very complete, did what he had to do, got the job done. That's the goal. But it's interesting to see even such a young driver with already so much success this season, it burns when he knows he's not the best on the day."

detailZh: 科拉平托从加斯利在蒙扎夺杆中学到了什么，帮助他在马德里实现突破
弗朗哥·科拉平托研究了皮埃尔·加斯利在蒙扎排位赛中获得优势的地方，并表示他在西班牙大奖赛上运用了这些经验
弗朗哥·科拉平托表示，研究皮埃尔·加斯利在蒙扎的排位赛表现帮助他在西班牙大奖赛上取得进步，他在进入第三节排位赛（Q3）后最终获得第七名。
科拉平托此前一直在寻找答案，因为在蒙扎排位赛中获得第八名，而他的阿尔卑斯车队队友加斯利却意外夺得杆位。
考虑到两人在周末早些时候的差距非常接近，这个结果显得尤为引人注目。在第一节排位赛中，当加斯利占据榜首时，科拉平托排名第四，仅落后0.050秒。
随着排位赛的进行，差距逐渐拉大。加斯利在第二节排位赛中快了0.3秒，在第三节排位赛中领先0.4秒。
“皮埃尔在整个排位赛中都非常快。在第一节排位赛时我和他非常接近，但我认为随着各节排位赛的进行，他的进步比我更大。在我这方面还有很多工作要做，需要去理解并学习他是如何在每一次尝试中都不断进步的，而我却稍稍落后了，”科拉平托当时说道。
科拉平托随后研究了蒙扎站的数据，以了解加斯利是如何在排位赛的推进过程中找到额外性能的。
一周之后在马德里，科拉平托在排位赛中始终比队友更快，并且成功闯入Q3，尽管他在Q2的第一次尝试中因在高速的拉纪念角（La Monumental）被赛道状况所坑而被迫放弃。
"马德里的排位赛是我做过的最好的排位赛之一，跑出了非常、非常完美的单圈，并把赛车带进了Q3。考虑到奥迪和小红牛的车在这里速度非常快，这一直会很有难度，"科拉平托在周日获得第七名后对包括Motorsport.com在内的媒体说。
"今天我们在比赛中保持领先，拿到了很多积分。所以我非常开心。再一次，一切都非常积极，我对速度和结果都很满意。"
科拉平托认为，他在蒙扎之后所做的准备为他在马德里的表现做出了贡献。
“我把所有事情都做到了极致，对此我非常满意。我认为在蒙扎之后，我从皮埃尔的排位赛中学到了很多，我尝试在这里更进一步。我做到了，并且再次把一切都发挥到了最大。”他说。
弗朗哥·科拉平托，阿尔派，皮埃尔·加斯利，阿尔派
当Motorsport.com专门问他在蒙扎从加斯利身上学到了什么时，科拉平托指出不仅仅是驾驶方面，还有这位更有经验的阿尔派车手在排位赛不同阶段如何管理赛车的能量。
“我想是多方面的吧，”他说。“他经验更丰富，他在各方面取得的进步都非常明显，无论是驾驶还是能量管理，从一轮到另一轮，从第一阶段排位赛（Q1）到第二阶段排位赛（Q2）再到第三阶段排位赛（Q3）。我从中学到了很多。”
科拉平托觉得这一点也反映在他自己在马德里排位赛中的进步上。
“我觉得在这条非常难开的赛道上，我在排位赛里状态真的很好。这里很可能是全年最难做出一个完美单圈的赛道，但一旦做到了，也是最有满足感的一条。第二节排位赛（Q2）和第三节排位赛（Q3）的两圈都非常精彩。
“又一次，我在那里前进了一步，这正是我所追求的。所以我对此感到高兴。”
detailEn: What Colapinto learned from Gasly's Monza pole to make his Madrid breakthrough
Franco Colapinto studied where Pierre Gasly had gained time through qualifying at Monza and says he applied those lessons at the Spanish Grand Prix
Franco Colapinto says studying Pierre Gasly's qualifying performance at Monza helped him make progress at the Spanish Grand Prix, where he finished seventh after reaching Q3.
Colapinto had been left searching for answers after qualifying eighth at Monza while his Alpine team-mate Gasly produced a surprise pole position.
The result was particularly notable given how closely matched the pair had been earlier in the weekend. In Q1, when Gasly topped the session, Colapinto was fourth and just 0.050 seconds behind.
The gap then increased as qualifying progressed. Gasly was three tenths faster in Q2 and four tenths ahead in Q3.

"Pierre was very quick throughout qualifying. In Q1 I was very close, and I think as the sessions went on, he kept improving more than I did. I have a lot to work on on my side to understand that and learn from how much he was improving with every attempt while I was falling a little bit behind," Colapinto said at the time.
Colapinto subsequently studied the data from Monza to understand where Gasly had been able to find additional performance as qualifying progressed.

A week later in Madrid, Colapinto was consistently faster than his team-mate through qualifying and reached Q3 despite having to abandon his first Q2 attempt after being caught out through the fast La Monumental corner.

"[Madrid] qualifying was one of the best qualifying sessions I've done, with very, very perfect laps and putting the car into Q3. It was always going to be tricky with the Audis and the RBs going very fast here," Colapinto told media including Motorsport.com after finishing seventh on Sunday.
"Today we stayed ahead in the race and scored a lot of points. So I'm very happy. Once again, it's extremely positive and I'm very happy with the pace and the results."
Colapinto believes the work he did following Monza contributed to his performance in Madrid.
"I ticked everything and I'm very pleased with that. I think after Monza I learned a lot from Pierre's qualifying and I tried to take a step here. I did it and I maximised everything again," he said.
Franco Colapinto, Alpine, Pierre Gasly, Alpine

Asked by Motorsport.com specifically what he had learned from Gasly at Monza, Colapinto pointed not only to driving but also to how the more experienced Alpine driver managed the car's energy through the different stages of qualifying.

"I think a bit of everything," he said. "He is more experienced and the steps he was making in everything, both in driving and energy management, from one run to another, from Q1 to Q2 to Q3, were very clear. I learned from that."
Colapinto felt that was reflected in his own progression through qualifying in Madrid.

"I think here I was really on it in qualifying, at a very difficult track. It's probably the most difficult one of the year to nail a lap and also the most satisfying one when you do it. Both Q2 and Q3 were amazing laps.
"Again, I took a step there and that's what I was looking for. So I'm happy with that."

items.summaryEn: In the Spanish Grand Prix, Lando Norris lost a likely victory due to the unlucky timing of a virtual safety car (VSC), ultimately finishing third. McLaren will analyze whether it could have handled the situation better.
detailZh: 即使最终获胜的基米·安东内利也几乎没有疑问，如果不是虚拟安全车出现得“极其不走运”，兰多·诺里斯本会赢得西班牙大奖赛。
当领先车手们跑完57圈中的第14圈时，兰斯·斯特罗尔的阿斯顿·马丁在20号弯的缓冲区停车，而这位卫冕世界冠军当时已经在马德里赛道的领先位置上建立起了相当可观的优势。
当赛事控制中心出动虚拟安全车以便回收斯特罗尔的赛车时，诺里斯已经过了维修区入口大约五秒钟，并且早已通过了最后一个弯道。
在那个时候，诺里斯再进维修区换胎已经太晚了，无法利用虚拟安全车让全场减速、进站损失时间减少的机会获利。与此同时，落后6.5秒的安东内利则正处于绝佳位置，可以立即驶入维修区。
在虚拟安全车持续出动、诺里斯缓慢绕行的同时，他已决定在下一圈结束时进站。
但就在他进入21号弯——进站入口前最后一个右弯——之前，虚拟安全车结束了。这意味着诺里斯在进站时损失了大约25秒的最大停站时间，而缓慢的换胎让情况雪上加霜。
这使他掉到第五位，落在乔治·拉塞尔之后。尽管诺里斯在比赛早段展现出明显的速度优势，但两个因素注定了他的命运：硬胎的衰退几乎可以忽略不计，而且除非轮胎差距很大，否则超车几乎不可能。
如果超车可行，那么迈凯伦领队安德里亚·斯特拉毫不怀疑比赛结果将会如何。
"我认为如果今天超车是可行的，诺里斯就会再次领跑，因为速度优势非常明显,"他说。
最终，诺里斯以第三名完赛，落后于安东内利（他承认自己很幸运）和马克斯·维斯塔潘。
尽管虚拟安全车出现的时机对诺里斯的伤害再糟糕不过了——出现得太晚以至于他无法做出反应，结束得太早以至于他无法从中受益——迈凯伦仍会分析自己是否本可以更好地处理这一局面。
而在接下来的几天里，车队将寻求两个关键问题的答案。
事后来看，很明显迈凯伦想要保住诺里斯的西班牙大奖赛冠军，最好的办法就是在斯特罗尔的状况正在发展时就立刻进站。
诚然，迈凯伦当时无法对虚拟安全车（VSC）的触发做出更快的反应，因为虚拟安全车出动时诺里斯早已驶过维修区入口，但车队确实想弄明白的一点是，是否有办法预判事态的发展方向。
因此，当车队回到沃金坐下来梳理细节时，它会想弄清楚，从斯特罗尔赛车的状态和位置所提供的信息来看，是否足以预先判断局势即将从双黄旗切换为虚拟安全车。
斯特罗尔的赛车因刹车故障停了下来，车头朝向护栏的一个缺口——但并没有完全穿过它。
在诺里斯即将到达之前，车队通过无线电警告他前方有黄旗，但似乎没有任何迹象表明这会是一起严重事故。
斯特罗尔一旦跳出赛车，赛事控制中心便确认 赛事干事（赛道工作人员）已经准备好回收这辆阿斯顿·马丁，并将它从缺口处推走。
只有当赛道官员暴露在护栏另一侧时，双黄旗事故才会升级为虚拟安全车（VSC）。
那么，从双黄旗升级为虚拟安全车（VSC）这一步骤，迈凯伦是否本可以预见呢？
从斯特罗尔赛车的位置来看，恐怕不会。
没有严重的损坏，也没有碎片散落一地，而且AMR26距离安全区只有几米。
因此，迈凯伦在得知斯特罗尔停车之后、到必须做出进站呼叫决定之间只有不到20秒，这段时间内掌握的信息是否足以让他们确信会引发安全车警示，是值得商榷的。
如果迈凯伦选择进站，而赛会最终只是用双黄旗处理了斯特罗尔的赛车，那么迈凯伦就会因为把一场胜利拱手让出而遭到猛烈批评。
正如斯特拉后来解释的那样：“如果判断错误，代价会极其惨重。从领跑位置看，你不必要地进了站，现在胜利就丢了。
“我认为一个好的原则是依据事实来应对，也就是赛道当时的真实状况。
“但我们肯定会回顾一下，看看在这种条件下，最终出动虚拟安全车是不是显而易见的结果。目前我无法回答。
但当时迈凯伦所不知道的是，赛事控制选择虚拟安全车方案的决定，还受到一个因素的影响，那就是希望清理五号弯赛道上的碎片。
弯道处留在赛道上的碳纤维碎片，极有可能来自第12圈阿隆索与塞恩斯的碰撞，明显有导致爆胎的风险，因此赛会有意将其清除——而这需要虚拟安全车。
所以，考虑到斯特罗尔的赛车所处的位置，出动虚拟安全车的决定是基于阿斯顿·马丁与赛道另一侧碎片的双重影响。
这也解释了为什么从斯特罗尔的赛车停在护栏后到虚拟安全车结束之间有将近一分钟的间隔。
虽然提前预判虚拟安全车显然才是正确的做法，但迈凯伦根本不可能知道赛会在决策时所考虑的全部因素——尤其是5号弯的碎片。
当虚拟安全车出动、诺里斯已驶过维修区入口时，迈凯伦在他再次绕回来之前无能为力。
车队在那圈叫他进站，显然是希望虚拟安全车继续下去，从而追平与上一圈已经进站的车手之间的差距。
迈凯伦直到最后一秒都以为虚拟安全车延长是因为赛道上有工作人员，但当诺里斯驶入21号弯时，警告期结束了。
此时诺里斯距离维修区入口还有10秒，但车队坚持执行进站的决定——尽管这意味着它将损失整整25秒，外加换胎所花的时间。
随后缓慢的进站又损失了更多时间，但最终也改变不了什么，因为迈凯伦认为诺里斯即便如此回到赛道后仍会排在拉塞尔身后。
这里最明显的问题是，迈凯伦是否本应放弃这次进站，继续推进以拉开更大的差距——然后在几圈之后再换胎。
从早段的节奏来看，这个理论听起来很美好，但现实是比赛中的轮胎状况意味着这种做法永远不会带来好处。
后面许多赛车换上的硬胎被证明是一款非常耐用的轮胎，磨损极小，也不需要太多的管理。
detailEn: There is little doubt, even from eventual winner Kimi Antonelli, that without the "insanely unlucky" timing of the virtual safety car, Lando Norris would have won the Spanish Grand Prix.

The reigning Formula 1 world champion had built up a comfortable advantage at the head of the Madring field when Lance Stroll’s Aston Martin stopped in the run off at Turn 20 as the leaders were on lap 14 of 57.
Norris was around five seconds past the pitlane entry, and well around the final corner, when race control called for a VSC to allow Stroll’s car to be recovered.

At that point it was too late for Norris to get into the pits for a change of tyres and capitalise on the reduced time loss of doing so while the field was slowed by the VSC. Meanwhile 6.5-seconds further back, Antonelli was perfectly positioned to dive in.
With the VSC remaining out as Norris toured around slowly, committed to going for his stop at the end of the following lap.

But just before he entered Turn 21, the final right hander before the pit entry, the VSC ended. It meant that, in taking his stop, Norris lost the maximum stop time of around 25 seconds – hampered further by a slow tyre change.

That dropped him to fifth behind George Russell. Despite the clear pace advantage he showed early on, Norris’s fate was sealed by two factors: tyre degradation on the hard was negligible and overtaking was nearly impossible unless there was a big tyre offset.
Had passing been on, then McLaren team principal Andrea Stella was in no doubt about what the race outcome would have been.
"I think if overtaking was possible today, we would have had Lando again in the lead because the pace advantage was significant," he said.
In the end, Norris came home third, behind Antonelli (who acknowledged he was lucky) and Max Verstappen.

While the timing of the VSC could not have been crueller in hurting Norris to the max – coming out too late for him to respond and finishing too early for him to benefit – McLaren will still analyse if it could have handled the situation better.
And there are two key questions that it will seek answers to over the coming days.
With the benefit of hindsight, it is obvious to say that the best way for McLaren to have saved Norris’s Spanish GP win would have been to stop the moment the Stroll situation was developing.

While it is true that there was nothing McLaren could have done to react quicker to the VSC being triggered, as Norris was well past the pit entry when it was called, an element it does want to understand better is if there was a way to predict where things were heading.

So when it sits down at Woking to dig through the details, it will want to understand if there was enough information from the state and location of Stroll’s car to pre-empt that the situation was going to switch from a double yellow to VSC imminently.
Stroll’s car, having suffered a brake problem, had come to a halt pointing towards a gap in the barriers – but had not gone all the way through it.
Norris had been warned over the radio shortly before arriving about there being a yellow flag, but there did not seem to be any indication that this would be a serious incident.
Once Stroll had jumped out the car, race control was happy that the marshals were ready to retrieve the Aston Martin and push it through the gap.
It is when track officials are exposed on the other side of the barriers that triggers a double yellow incident being escalated to VSC.
So was this step from a double yellow to a VSC something that McLaren could have predicted?
Based on the positioning of Stroll’s car, probably not.
There was no major damage, no debris scattered everywhere and the AMR26 was only a few metres from safety.

So it is debatable if there was enough information in the less than 20 seconds McLaren had between being aware Stroll had stopped and the chance to make a pitstop call to be convinced that this was going to trigger a caution period.
Had it opted to go for a stop, and then race control managed to deal with Stroll’s car under double yellows, McLaren would have been lambasted for throwing a win away.
As Stella later explained: "If you get it wrong, it would be extremely penalising. From the lead, you pit unnecessarily and now you lost the victory.
"I think a good rule is to respond to what is a fact, to what is the real condition of the circuit.
"But we will definitely take a look as to whether in these conditions it was just simply obvious that it would end up in a virtual safety car. I cannot answer at the moment."
But what was not known to McLaren at the time as well was that race control’s decisions about going for the VSC option was influenced by a desire to clear up debris on the track at Turn 5 as well.

Parts of carbon fibre left on the circuit at the chicane, most likely from the collision between Fernando Alonso and Carlos Sainz on lap 12, posed a clear risk of causing punctures and there was a desire to remove it – which would require a VSC.
So with Stroll’s car in the position it was, the decision to go for the caution was based on the double influence of the Aston Martin and the track debris at the other side of the circuit.
This also explains why there was nearly one minute between Stroll's car being behind the barriers and the VSC ending.

While pre-empting the VSC would obviously have been the right thing to do, there would have been no way for McLaren to know about all the influences race control had in its decisions – especially the Turn 5 debris.
With the VSC out and Norris past the pitlane entry, there was nothing McLaren could do before he came around again.
It made a call to bring him in that lap, obviously in the hope that the VSC continued so the deficit to those who had stopped on the previous lap was equalised.
McLaren thought until the last second that the extended VSC was due to marshals being on the track, but as Norris rolled into Turn 21 the caution period ended.

Norris was 10 seconds from the pitlane entry at this point but the team committed to seeing through on its decision to stop – even though it meant it would lose the full 25s plus what it took for a tyre change.
The subsequent slow stop, which cost more time, ultimately changed little as McLaren thinks Norris would still have returned to the track behind Russell.
The obvious question to be asked here is whether McLaren should have abandoned the stop and pushed on to build up more of a gap – and then changed tyres a few laps later.
The theory is nice based on the pace early on, but the reality was that the tyre situation in the race meant it was never going to prove beneficial.
The hard that many of the cars behind had switched to had proved to be a very robust tyre, with minimal degradation and not needing too much management.
keyPointsZh: 斯特罗尔在第14圈（共57圈）时将阿斯顿·马丁停在了20号弯的缓冲区，比赛控制随即出动虚拟安全车。
诺里斯当时已过维修区入口约五秒，并通过了最后一个弯角，已来不及进站利用虚拟安全车期间损失时间较少的优势。
安东内利落后约6.5秒，位置正好可以进站，最终因此获益夺冠。
keyPointsEn: The VSC was triggered after Norris had passed the pit entry and ended before he pitted, costing him around 25 seconds of pit stop time.
Minimal degradation on the hard tyre and near-impossible overtaking prevented Norris from recovering positions.
Race control's decision to deploy the VSC was also influenced by debris at Turn 5, which McLaren was unaware of at the time.
